guidance:
# Source registry — practitioner protocols [P] and evidence tags

Rules in the source-tagged reference files carry a source tag and a confidence label; this is the canonical legend (each reference file points here). Official tags ([H-off], [BD-off], [MM-off], [F], [R-off], [OAI-off], [A]) point to vendor documentation; [W] to multi-source web research; [PP] to first-party production sessions and director decisions. This file itemizes the practitioner protocols so a [P] number is checkable.

**Tag legend (canonical):**
- 🟢 verified — multi-source, official, or production-proven · 🟡 plausible — single-source or untested · 🔴 marketing claim — verify yourself · ⚠️ source conflict — the sentence next to the marker settles it (SKILL.md Precedence).
- [PP] first-party production-session evidence · [W] multi-source web research · [A] platform academy docs.
- [H-off] Higgsfield official · [BD-off] ByteDance official guide (via verified reproductions) · [MM-off] MiniMax official H3 prompt-writing guides · [F] fal.ai official · [R-off] Runway official · [OAI-off] OpenAI cookbook/docs · [X-ext] community skill, partially officially confirmed.
- [G2] / [NB] GPT Image 2 / Nano Banana guide clusters · [G2-gallery] GPT Image 2 official prompt-gallery patterns.
- [P1–P50] practitioner and vendor-thread protocols — itemized in the table below; P1–P16 are not itemized and count as single-source 🟡.
- Unlabeled text (SKILL.md, workflows, production-bible, film-craft, director-recipes, genre-baselines, worked-example) is house doctrine and ranks as 🟢.

House-doctrine green is not independently live-verified API evidence.
incompatibilities: Source examples are not project canon. Provider and platform claims retain their source date and require current route evidence.

provenance.adaptation:
Complete source sections. Apply these NGV adaptations before source imperatives:
ngv-phase-order: The active pack owns phase order. Musicvideo remains Track → optional Lyrics → Init → approved Analysis → optional existing material → story. Use W10 knowledge inside the relevant existing phases; a replacement phase graph requires an explicit decision.
ngv-canon: Map bible roles to NGV canonical writers/artifacts and cumulative exact-byte lineage. Do not create an independent markdown authority. Draft/proposal and approval remain different states; phase edits require explicit rewind.
ngv-greenfield: Musicvideo may be greenfield: propose story or nonnarrative concept from approved audio analysis and optional lyrics. Missing existing story files never block development. Execution prompts cannot silently invent unapproved beats.
ngv-language: App interaction follows explicit app localization or an explicit language request. Generated model prompts remain English with literal dialogue in the declared dialogue language. Preserve user-supplied text as input/provenance; the normal route still precompiles it, never bypasses the prompt engine.
ngv-hybrid: Reusable craft, coverage, structure, review and finishing also apply to imported/live_action/ai_enhanced shots. Generation-only anchors, paid routes and draft renders are conditional on source mode. Retain zero-generation musicvideo/film workflows.
ngv-anchor-modes: Record reference anchor, exact keyframe interpolation, frame continuation and native video extension as different proposed modes. #485 must settle integration with locked chained-shot semantics. Existing predecessor-last-frame-only chain remains unchanged until that decision.
ngv-provider-evidence: These are dated source claims, not live verified capabilities. Keep original date/confidence/route. Executability comes from enabled providers intersected with actual route support. Never transplant a UI field into an API or enable a provider from this corpus.
ngv-spend: Preserve the diagnostic counting protocol and escalation thresholds as configurable policy. Every paid operation stays inside explicit cost/batch authorization (#480); never automatically spend through the entire suggested budget. A paid diagnostic is not a free validation.
ngv-style-scope: Bind each selected criterion to its actual frame/shot/sequence/project scope and evidence modality. Technical provenance gates remain deterministic; aesthetic reviews require viewed media or attributed director review. A local fault on a usable production take follows scoped repair before regeneration.
ngv-performance-audio: Musicvideo master audio is the original track. Referenced segments can drive performance/lip sync without becoming replacement soundtrack. Singing, spoken dialogue, VO, ambience and score are separate roles with explicit mouth ownership; keep scope of music-bleed exception.
ngv-documentary: For actual documentary, paper edit selects attributed, consented source transcript ranges; no invented witness quote or synthetic footage passed off as evidence. Authored or reenacted interviews are a separately declared synthetic mode, preserving source/disclosure provenance.
ngv-abi-and-pins: Use versioned resources/new extension artifacts under existing registration and loader. Do not add stored fields to compatible public V1 value types. Existing projects retain pinned pack/profile/library versions; migration is explicit and transactional.
ngv-style-risk: A deliberate style may accept a named aesthetic imperfection; it does not excuse wrong identity, anatomy, unapproved canon changes or provenance gaps. Distinguish intentional camera following from accidental floating camera.
ngv-examples: Keep example and template content available in full, but instantiate only from actual project data and verified route. Never promote example light/weather/plot, prices, IDs or account names into canon.
ngv-legal: Preserve attribution, consent, rights and disclosure procedures and the source date. Do not compile jurisdiction-specific legal conclusions into an automatic green gate. No additional legal research or advice is asserted by this extraction.
ngv-knowledge-scope: Keep every actionable item locally; select the relevant complete procedure/recipe and its governing exceptions per task. Do not inject all files, silently truncate the selected procedure, or mistake a small initial library for complete migration.
ngv-readable-overlays: Preserve the chosen recording-format tell or chapter-card intent as an NLE overlay/title with exact text where needed; do not ask the video generator to render reliable readable text. Non-text recording artifacts remain generation style. This is an explicit NGV realization of both source intentions, not a claim that the source contains this reconciliation.
